name.description: How a reader calls the service, for example mysql.

port.description: The port the dependency listens on. Required: it is what the reference is matched by.

name.description: Short name, unique in this file.

prepare.description: Optional foreground command run immediately before cmd.

cmd.description: The command that brings the service back up, run from cwd.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the directory holding oberth.yaml.

port.description: The port the service binds (1-65535), or auto to let option-berth pick one.

health.description: HTTP path that answers when the service is up.

depends_on.description: Names of services that must be started first.

env.description: Environment added when option-berth starts the service. Values may use ${port}, ${url}, and another service's port or url as ${name.port} or ${name.url}.

name.description: The group this project is known by. Defaults to the directory name when absent.

services.description: Services option-berth starts and stops for this project.

machine.description: Services the machine already runs that the project depends on. References only: option-berth never starts or stops them.

ports.description: Extra ports the project claims beyond its services.

worktree_ports.description: How many ports a linked-worktree claim takes by default.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL for editor completion and validation.

title: option-berth manifest
description: An oberth.yaml manifest: the services one worktree declares. Generated from the Go types in internal/groups; do not edit by hand. Run `go generate ./...`.
